tools.name: search_rv_worksheets
tools.description: Search a bounded catalog of 13 free blank U.S. campervan/RV worksheets by a short topic. Returns matching form summaries and verified PDF links; it does not search the web or provide general RV advice. Use topic words, not personal details.

tools.name: get_rv_worksheet
tools.description: Return one public blank worksheet by its two-digit catalog ID (01–13): purpose, public section/field labels, limits, pages and verified download link. It never requests, stores, or returns completed form values, and gives no equipment diagnosis.

tools.name: plan_first_rv_trip
tools.description: Select and order existing public worksheets for a first trip, overnight stop and follow-up. Options add the equipment-specific storage inventory or technician report.
